root_text:
🚨 BREAKING: Guwahati reports its first case of Human Metapneumovirus (#HMPV).

A 75-year-old woman is stable, while her 80-year-old husband requires oxygen support.

Earlier, a 10-month-old from Lakhimpur was also diagnosed.  

#Guwahati #H
